topography.project_purpose: HOPE Money is a DeFi protocol offering liquid staking, restaking, and BTC-backed tokens. It enables users to stake ETH for liquid tokens, restake for additional yield, and mint BTC-pegged assets for use in lending and trading.
topography.relationship_narrative: The liquid staking family provides RockXETH, which can be restaked for rewards. BTC-backed tokens rely on vaults and rate oracles, and cross-chain infrastructure enables movement of these assets across networks.
